result.title: Generalization Bounds via Vector-Valued $L_p$ Correlation $V_α$
result.summary: Understanding generalization of randomized learning algorithms remains a central challenge. Mutual-information and total-variation bounds provide complementary ways to quantify data--hypothesis dependence, but they can behave quite differently in high-dimensional regimes. We study a one-parameter family of dependence measures, the vector-valued $L_p$-norm correlation $V_α$, and derive generalization bounds whose dependence terms interpolate between total variation (TV) at $α=1$ and variance and $χ^2$ related behavior at $α=2$. For $α>2$, the Hölder-conjugate loss moment is below two, yielding heavy-tailed specializations that can remain finite even when the loss variance is infinite. A particularly interpretable specialization occurs at $α=2$, where the bound can be expressed in terms of the variability of the algorithm's output density across datasets, $\int \sqrt{\mathrm{Var}_S[p(w\mid S)]}~ dw$. We show that the entire $V_α$ family is invariant under smooth bijective reparameterizations of the hypothesis space. We also introduce an adaptive density stability (ADS) condition that implies explicit control of $V_2$, and we verify it for Gibbs-type posteriors under bounded losses (yielding rates that depend on the inverse temperature and sample size). To address scaling, we extend the framework to a conditional formulation using supersamples, analogous in spirit to conditional mutual information (CMI), and discuss evaluations in the output space as a practical surrogate for estimating dependence. Simulations on Bayesian linear regression illustrate how tuning $α$ can change the tightness of the resulting bounds across regimes. Additional supersample experiments on noisy MNIST and on a pretrained ResNet-50 for CIFAR-10 show similar behavior of the projected loss-space bounds beyond the original clean-MNIST setting.

AI.brief_summary: 研究向量值 Lp 范数相关度量 V_α 这一单参数依赖性度量族，推导在 α=1 到 α=2 间插值 TV 与方差／χ² 行为的泛化界，并给出重参数化不变性、自适应密度稳定性条件及超样本条件化扩展。
AI.relevance_reason: 其对假设空间光滑双射重参数化不变的输出密度依赖性度量，可能为量化「latent 状态对视觉证据的依赖强度」提供思路；但该文是纯泛化界理论、不涉及推理机制，能否用于 LVR 诊断尚需核查其可估计性与输出空间代理评估。
